could_not_verify: A standalone /audit-build after a satisfied /verify-build closes on code no verification saw, when its fix run changes code (D20, TR4). Reached only when no deferred close is on record: features built before this change, a Step 7.3 that errored, or an audit that ended open, capped or STUCK. /ship-build's custody check starts at that fix run's head (anchorCommit), so it does not re-prove the fix run's work either. Today's behaviour, now confined to that case. Out of scope for a code audit: a residual risk the design accepts, seen only in practice. The owner acts: after such an audit, if its readout says the fix run changed code, run /verify-build before shipping.
